sentences.en: Mariko's parents are strongly opposed to her marrying an American.
sentences.zh: Mariko的父母强烈反对她嫁给一个美国人。

sentences.en: I also think 'living hell' is putting it too strongly.
sentences.zh: '活地狱'这个说法有点夸张了。我认为这样说也太过分了。

sentences.en: I strongly advise you to take this medicine right away.
sentences.zh: 我强烈建议你马上服用这种药。

phrases.zh: 对……很在意，对……有强烈的看法

senses.zh: 坚强地；激烈地；强有力地；气味浓地
